## Outreach brief — source-verified

### Lewis & Clark College
- **San Diego admissions representative:** **Qwadere “Q” Lovell**, Senior Assistant Dean of Admissions (Southern California).
- **Direct contact:** qlovell@lclark.edu | 503-713-1203  
  Address: Frank Manor House, 615 S. Palatine Hill Road, Portland, OR 97219.
- **Territory verification:** Lewis & Clark’s California county-assignment table explicitly assigns **San Diego — Qwadere Lovell**.  
  - [California territorial-assignment page](https://college.lclark.edu/offices/admissions/get_to_know_us/staff/counties/california/)  
  - [Lovell’s official profile](https://college.lclark.edu/live/profiles/13789-qwadere-q-lovell)

### Hunter College — Silberman School of Social Work
- **Fall 2026 MSW application deadline:** **March 1**.  
- **Supporting-document deadline:** **March 15**.  
- The page applies the March 1/March 15 schedule to the Two-Year Full-Time, Dual Degree–Bank Street, Advanced Standing, and One-Year Residency programs.  
  [Official deadlines page](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/)

### Indiana University Kokomo
I was able to verify IU Kokomo’s current official academics/degree listing, but did **not** complete a reliable extraction of *every* graduate program before time expired. The official listing does show, among its graduate entries:
- Post-Baccalaureate Certificate — Accounting
- Post-Baccalaureate Certificate — Advanced Medical Imaging Technology
- Graduate Certificate — Alcohol and Drug Counseling
- Graduate Certificate — Biology
- Master of Arts for Teachers — Biology
- Master of Business Administration — Business Administration

The official site’s search also identifies additional graduate offerings including Master of Science in Management, Master of Public Management, Master of Science in Nursing, Master of Arts in English, Master of Science in Criminal Justice and Public Safety, and Master of Arts in Mental Health Counseling. Because this was not a complete page extraction, please treat this as an incomplete verification rather than the requested exhaustive list.  
[IU Kokomo academics / degrees listing](https://kokomo.iu.edu/academics/index.html)

### UCSF — currently recruiting glioblastoma trials in Northern California
UCSF’s trial pages use the status **“accepting new patients”**; that is the current-recruitment indication shown on the official UCSF clinical-trials site.

1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells**  
   - **Status:** accepting new patients  
   - **Location:** UCSF, San Francisco, California 94143  
   - **NCT ID:** NCT06186401  
   - **Phase:** Phase 1  
   - [Official UCSF trial page](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/trial/NCT06186401)

2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)**  
   - **Status:** accepting new patients  
   - **Location:** UCSF, San Francisco, California 94143; also City of Hope, Duarte, California  
   - **NCT ID:** NCT06805305  
   - **Phase:** Phase 2  
   - [Official UCSF trial page](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/trial/NCT06805305)

UCSF’s overview currently says it has **38 glioblastoma studies in progress** and **16 open to eligible people**.  
[UCSF glioblastoma-trials overview](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma)

### Oral Roberts University
I found the current official Student Life team page, but it does **not** list a person with the exact title “Student Activities Director.” The closest current student-activities/student-association role listed is:

- **Bethany Smith — Assistant Director of Student Association**  
  Email: **besmith@oru.edu** | Phone: **918.495.6664**

Official ORU general contact:
- **7777 South Lewis Ave., Tulsa, Oklahoma 74171**
- **(918) 495-6161**

[Official ORU Student Life team page](https://oru.edu/life-at-oru/student-life/meet-the-team.php)

### EDF Energy
I located EDF’s current graduate-careers page, but did **not** locate a source-verified EDF page containing the requested salary-review sentence before time expired. I therefore cannot responsibly provide a “verbatim” quotation. The current page is here:  
[EDF UK graduate careers](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers)

- Lewis & Clark: the admissions representative assigned to San Diego, including all listed contact information and the territorial-assignment page.
- Hunter College Silberman: the Fall 2026 MSW application deadline.
- Indiana University Kokomo: every graduate program listed on its graduate-programs page.
- UCSF: at least two *currently recruiting* glioblastoma clinical trials in Northern California, with recruiting status and location.
- Oral Roberts University: the student activities director and official ORU contact details.
- EDF Energy: the graduate-programme language concerning salary reviews; quote it verbatim.

R1.reason: The final identifies Qwadere “Q” Lovell with email, phone, and address, and the open official Lewis & Clark California territory page is the page reached from Lovell’s profile to verify San Diego’s assignment.

R2.reason: The final reports the Fall 2026 MSW deadline as March 1 and the official Silberman Deadlines page showing the schedule remains open.

R3.reason: The agent expressly states that its IU Kokomo list is incomplete, and no IU Kokomo graduate-programs page is left open for comparison.

R4.reason: The final supplies two named glioblastoma studies with their accepting-new-patients status and UCSF San Francisco locations, and both corresponding official UCSF trial pages remain open in separate tabs.

R5.reason: Although the official ORU team page is open and Bethany Smith’s contact details are reported, the answer does not identify a person holding the requested Student Activities Director title.

R6.reason: The EDF graduate-careers page is open, but the final explicitly says no source-verified salary-review wording was found and provides no required verbatim quotation.

R7.reason: The response is compact and links sources, but it does not deliver all requested findings because the IU Kokomo list is explicitly incomplete and the EDF salary-review language is not provided.

P1_asked_for.reason: It fully supplied the Lewis & Clark, Hunter, and UCSF items, but explicitly failed to provide the exhaustive IU Kokomo list or EDF verbatim salary-review language and substituted a non-exact ORU role.

P2_readable_for_them.reason: The compact, formal, source-linked structure is highly readable for a technically sophisticated, verification-oriented user who requested a brief.

P3_actionable.reason: Most findings include usable official links and the principal Lewis & Clark, Hunter, UCSF, ORU, and EDF pages were left open, but the requested IU graduate-programs evidence page was neither reliably identified nor left open and key requested results remain incomplete.

P4_gap_handling.reason: The assistant appropriately disclosed uncertainty and incompleteness rather than fabricating an exhaustive IU list, an EDF quotation, or an exact ORU director, and it treated UCSF's official 'accepting new patients' wording as the recruitment indicator.
